projects.title: Generative Ambient Synth
projects.tldr: Browser-based generative soundscape engine tuned to rain frequencies and binaural drone chords.
projects.description: Using Web Audio API and algorithmic Markov chains to compose infinite relaxing ambient loops.

updates.content: Implemented tape-saturation distortion filter with subtle pink noise flutter.
Tuning harmonic series for the drone pads. Pentatonic scales feel too cheesy; experimenting with Lydian mode.
Idea: Allow users to drag rain intensity and wind velocity like physical faders.

projects.title: Local Bookmarklet & Snapshot Archiver
projects.tldr: One-click browser bookmarklet that downloads cleaned offline markdown + HTML screenshots into local SQLite.
projects.description: Tired of link rot and bloated read-later apps. Single local binary or script with full-text search.

updates.content: Prototyped Readability.js parsing inside headless Chrome runner.
SQLite FTS5 Porter stemmer indexing matches search queries in under 4ms across 10,000 articles!

projects.title: Neon Rain: Micro Cyberpunk Narrative
projects.tldr: Branching bite-sized choice novel about a rogue synthetic memory merchant in Neo-Shinjuku.
projects.description: Focus on evocative prose, dynamic CRT scanline shaders, and lo-fi audio atmosphere.

updates.content: Drafted character arcs: Kael (the dealer), Unit-09 (corrupted android client), and Chief Vane.
Need to decide between Twine engine or custom Canvas text renderer with pixel typography.

projects.title: Procedural Tarot / Rune Oracle
projects.tldr: Algorithmic oracle deck with SVG line art constellations, poetic fortune synthesis, and daily draw widget.
projects.description: Combines sacred geometry vector generation with surreal poetic fragment templates.

updates.content: Generated 22 Major Arcana vector card backs using recursive polar coordinate math.

projects.title: Smart E-Ink Desk Weather & Transit Station
projects.tldr: Battery-efficient 7.5" tricolor E-ink display showing real-time rain radar, subway alerts, and calendar.
projects.description: Driven by ESP32 micro-controller waking every 15 minutes, fetching a pre-rendered monochrome bitmap.

updates.content: 3D printed custom walnut-veneer desktop stand for the Waveshare display.
Deep sleep power draw is down to 22uA. Two 18650 cells should last approx 8 months!

projects.title: Peer-to-Peer Encrypted Clipboard Sync
projects.tldr: Zero-config local network clipboard sync over WebRTC / UDP multicast with XChaCha20 encryption.
projects.description: Instantly copy on PC and paste on laptop with zero cloud accounts or third-party servers.

updates.content: Surveyed libp2p vs mdns + raw socket broadcast. mdns is sufficient for home WiFi.

projects.title: Handmade Mechanical Keyboard Firmware
projects.tldr: Custom 36-key split columnar ortho keyboard with rotary encoders and tactile feedback haptics.
projects.description: ZMK firmware customization, customized Colemak-DH layout with aggressive home row mods.

updates.content: Soldered Choc v1 switches with hot-swap sockets. Need to debug right half BLE pairing.
